_: What the scene's executors can actually do, per channel: target -> actions. Two checks read this. tools/events-check.mjs refuses an event whose track names a target/action not listed here (it would fire, log, align, and do nothing). In the page, window.__events.verifyVocabulary() asks every registered executor whether it supports each entry — so this file cannot drift ahead of the code either. Adding a capability means: implement it in the executor, list it here, then author events against it. Targets in braces are drawn per event; the check resolves them against every value the draw's pool can produce.
